# Hawk Berry's Open Source Support

> Official support site for Hawk Berry's open-source software projects.

This site provides support information, funding options, and project links for Hawk Berry's open-source software.

## Projects

- [`finra-py`](https://github.com/hawkberry/finra-py/): Open-source Python client for the FINRA API Platform.

## Documentation

- [`finra-py` Documentation](https://finra.hawkberry.com/): User guide, API reference, examples, and consulting information.

## Support

- [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/hawkberry): Support ongoing open-source development.
- [Support Page](https://support.hawkberry.com/): Funding options, cryptocurrency addresses, and project support information.
